### Key Differences

- **Congener levels:** Vodka is heavily filtered and distilled for purity, giving it very low congener levels. Rum—especially dark, aged, or spiced varieties—contains higher levels of congeners (such as propanol) that can intensify headaches, nausea, and fatigue. Light/white rum sits closer to vodka on the spectrum than dark rum.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF19yt5_qHtqkj2L_a0rVbnNm3Hrh9bL4kfbnabSUAJYnhVH5wJ95y8bmZ3ZcNUigpjfCBCDyMIPZQvMR8fy8ozX6Qd7JULNlEJgGubU2t1QPFak5VYNj6Q5U8lMRA1lTwY6kV_xpFCL1zFLmeSLRvPryVve5rSezFLggimSFAfezIKtmMZ5Y)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF11tekjiTnxegwi7anp7NBtaFOQGeEkVd2_dDBawNe1a69Zr8SmQ0NlhLRwf7cteNbJ5aaKeOsM-bG9j35I6r86-xdtylYX0rqJ5DD6VY93ZU6OAwbDXv0Bzy-BXyl_sRWsCwzUgVi8hCp5G9WnQGV42GhHXGB5XhZDiWs2KutXEIn4OZcfgkEd1ieKYxl1VvWgdT-CZ1CfGn)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXeZxOa9eaHRFpUzP256V02bAPgGzkhQdq-7SGAdmOr-BmAb87TAunmFZPBU_iXWADwS7ECSWhnON6hEaNCmdT4sHQCBDMMbLW1A8ba8n-YMeea2tSSYQf7iKyunjm7J0K-J3QPd2V8mmWCwqaonO7-WU)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF10fz1404bCT0yAF9hfpzGgdpDB2lf2IrujbWUq05XVPN67xlBWaPcaBfRL6lSuJHOgl9TSsv1OdVeCZxgEANSif3OYM_dFPjjIwRINXdgttaTsqOIIwAk2MjYxJtYKseuxrHpi7oXnxcvQ4g3fwdPZbfCR0hRB2WoQujEXOB7QM5EHCEac5XsXOh)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX6-5sFvxINUPjBiMFaYD2FZs7rCwukXAsRs99BA8xLX7yN0kKXP2v9ehAROGsKn3ToFClHkoy06xch6zumV57X1NWyjOwVXeUVFYqOz1IChL9ufQ43OkVdvlF1U7bfhGBbYrHRMVaLw)
